fee_notes: $55,000 for single concept (Junk or Move) standard Zone; $75,000 for combined Junk+Move standard Zone. Small market fee = 20% of Zone population ($750-$49,999.90). Conversion franchise: current fee minus 10% of prior-year sales, max $30,000 discount. Veteran discount: $7,500 off. Additional Zone: $65,000. Fractional Zone: $20,000 per 100,000 population.
raw_excerpt: you must pay to us an initial franchise fee of $55,000 for a standard Zone. If you purchase a College Hunks Hauling Junk® franchise and a College Hunks Moving® franchise concurrently, the initial franchise fee is $75,000 for a standard Zone.
